purpose: Hash-pinned frozen JSON inputs for the code-native Round-4 Figure 1. The renderer reads only these numeric artifacts, refuses mismatched bytes, and formats percentage labels with Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to match manuscript rounding (for example, 0.8085 -> 80.9%).
layout_accessibility: The active code-native figure uses a 7.8 x 4.05 inch two-row canvas. Its smallest raw panel label is 8.25pt; at the approximately 6.5 inch manuscript text width this is approximately 6.9pt effective, so the 100%-page rendering is intended to be readable without zoom.
scope_boundary: The oracle-versus-fitted/CAL diagram is explanatory. Parsed numerical labels summarize frozen count-replay artifacts; synthetic drift and margin values are exploratory/nonconfirmatory and do not establish ordered online behavior, gold correctness, or operational cost.
